## mesh.annular-solid-3d (0.1.0)

Generate an owned indexed-triangle closed annular solid from explicit inner and outer radii, two axial planes, angular subdivision, and a required face budget. It retains local positions, flat unit normals, face kinds, and angular-cell identity; it does not draw.

Contract status: reviewed.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "outerRadius": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Finite caller local outer radius, strictly greater than innerRadius.",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0
    },
    "innerRadius": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Finite caller local hole radius, strictly positive and less than outerRadius.",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0
    },
    "bottomZ": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Finite caller local lower axial coordinate, strictly less than topZ."
    },
    "topZ": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Finite caller local upper axial coordinate, strictly greater than bottomZ."
    },
    "slices": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 3,
      "maximum": 89478485,
      "description": "Angular cell count. This floor(INT_MAX/24) ceiling is representational only, not a useful-resolution or allocation promise."
    },
    "maxFaces": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 715827881,
      "description": "Required caller face-work limit. Its signed-int packed-representation ceiling is not a practical-work or artistic recommendation."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "outerRadius",
    "innerRadius",
    "bottomZ",
    "topZ",
    "slices",
    "maxFaces"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

| parameter | unit | default | encouraged range | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| outerRadius | caller local distance | null | null | aros motivates an outer annular boundary; the private study uses150 only as a discrete setting, not a default or range. |
| innerRadius | caller local hole radius | null | null | aros motivates a visible inner boundary; private110 and60 settings demonstrate a width edit, not a range. |
| bottomZ | caller local axial distance | null | null | The private study changes the paired axial endpoints from±15 to±45 for depth; no independent default or range is established. |
| topZ | caller local axial distance | null | null | The private study changes the paired axial endpoints from±15 to±45 for depth; no independent default or range is established. |
| slices | integer angular cells | null | null | Private48 and12 settings demonstrate a facet edit.89478485 is representation-only. |
| maxFaces | retained triangle work limit | null | null | Explicit all-or-error resource boundary.715827881 is an index-representation ceiling, not an allocation guarantee or artistic range. |

`null` means no default or encouraged range is approved.

Current implementation status comes from a separately reviewed attestation, not this immutable contract.

## color.cyclic-palette (0.1.0)

Immutable ordered opaque sRGB8 palette sampled by a phase in cycles, with linear encoded-channel interpolation and fixed RGB24 quantization.

Contract status: reviewed.

```json
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
| colors | ordered RGB24 values (0xRRGGBB encoded sRGB8) | null | null | mountain4#2, pelines#1 and Cuadricula#1 use ordered colour lists. Preserve caller artwork and duplicate entries. RGB24 and opaque-only scope are portable design choices, not a claim about every host colour type. Nonempty length <=2^31-1 is a cross-target index representability bound, not an artistic range or allocation guarantee. |
| phase | cycles through the whole palette | null | null | Source helpers use entry coordinates; public cycles remove palette-length coupling. mountain4 dc random(0.099,0.1) -> random(0.3,0.4) reports moderate colour change with fixed geometry, but does not establish a recommended phase/rate range. pelines palette replacement changes background too; Cuadricula experiments are unscored. |

## topology.delaunay-2d (0.1.0)

Produce owned exact planar Delaunay topology from an ordered finite binary64 site list and explicit deterministic work budget. It computes canonical unique vertices, input mappings, positive indexed faces, unique edges and final face incidence only; it has no random stream, renderer, palette, clipping, site sampler or draw side effect.

```json
        },

        }
      ],
      "items": false,
      "minItems": 2,
      "maxItems": 2
    }
  }
}
```

| angleScale | radians per field scalar unit | null | null | Ciserp amp changes a randomized distribution; it is not a scalar range. Prototype40 with gradient[0,1] is a technique-level choice, not signed simplex equivalence. |

## motion.target-springs-2d (0.1.0)

Advance an ordered independent target-spring state by one explicit logical step: target force, position using updated velocity, then velocity retention. State carries each body's position, velocity and coefficients. Native execution owns a mutable fixed-size batch with atomic steps and detached observations; no pointer, clock, RNG, renderer, topology or convergence guarantee.

```json
                    "type": "number"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "number"
                  }
                ],
                "items": false,
                "minItems": 2,
                "maxItems": 2
              },
              "velocity": {
                "type": "array",
                "prefixItems": [
                  {
                    "type": "number"
                  },

                    "type": "number"
                  }
                ],
                "items": false,
                "minItems": 2,
                "maxItems": 2

              "strength": {

            ],

      ],

    },
    "targets": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 0,
      "maxItems": 357913941,
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "prefixItems": [
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          }
        ],
        "items": false,
        "minItems": 2,
        "maxItems": 2
      }

  "required": [

    "targets"
```

| parameter | unit | default | encouraged range | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| state.bodies | ordered independent systems | null | null | araniaaas retains a collection of positions/velocities; owned fixed-size state is a design divergence. Count ceiling is packed signed32 representation only. |
| position | caller coordinate pair | null | null | Source pos; explicit arbitrary initial positions enable external layouts and snapshot restore. Finite binary64 model, no clipping. |
| velocity | coordinate displacement per logical step | null | null | Source vel; explicit nonzero state enables replay/impulses. No hidden zero default. |
| strength | target-displacement contribution to advanced velocity per step | null | null | Source0.025; controlled0/.0125/.025/.05 investigation shows distinct temporal response. Nonnegative finite is a restorative-force model boundary, not an encouraged range. Per-body strength is explicit independent-system generalization. evidence/parameter-experiments/cp10-spring-response/decision.md |
| retention | fraction of advanced velocity retained after position update | null | null | Source per-point random(0.8,0.9)*0.8; controlled0/.7/.9/1 investigation shows different persistence/reversals. Mathematical0..1 keeps/discards velocity; no inversion/amplification model. No stability or default claim. evidence/parameter-experiments/cp10-spring-response/decision.md |
| targets | one caller coordinate pair per body per step | null | null | Source target return and pointer force are separate example policies; supplied targets remove host-global input. No coefficient, seed, time or palette mutation. |

`null` means no default or encouraged range is approved.
